channel.title: Navan Badminton Club
channel.description: Welcome to Navan Badminton Club located at Claremont Stadium in Navan, Co. Meath, Ireland. Club nights every Monday and Wednesday during the season which runs from September to April. Club caters for Adults and Juveniles of all standards from beginner to advanced.

item.title: Monday Club Night at Claremont Stadium: Match Night, Two Courts & Juvenile Club
item.description: Monday Club Night is back in Claremont Stadium with Grade 7 Mens (Navan ‘B’ vs Drumree), two adult courts from 8:30pm, and Juvenile Club sessions for girls (6:30pm) and boys (7:30pm).
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Wednesday Club Night
item.description: Three matches tonight at 8:00pm sharp (Grade 2 Mixed, Grade 6 Mens, Grade 7 Mens). Courts open for members from 9:30pm. Juvenile Club is for league matches only.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: 🏸 Wednesday Navan Badminton Club Nights are BACK for 2026!
item.description: Join us at Claremont Stadium for an exciting evening of badminton with fixtures for Grade 3 Ladies and Juvenile League matches.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)

item.title: Open Night at Claremont Stadium
item.description: Join us this Wednesday for an open night at Claremont Stadium with all courts open and a session for future legends.
item.author: badminton@navanbadmintonclub.com (Navan Badminton Club)
